name: Mimikos Local OpenAPI Mock Server
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed local OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 mock server with deterministic and in-memory stateful API responses; no provider-enforced usage quota or expiration for the self-run software.
watch_out: Alpha (0.x): output and behavior may change between minor versions. Stateful resources are in memory and lost on restart; default maximum is 10,000 resources (configurable). Self-run binary only; hosting, CI runners and external integrations are not included. Go 1.25+ required when building from source.
